title: Word Formation: Od rzeczownika do przymiotnika (krok 1: koncowki)

tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie jednym wyrazem, przeksztalcajac wyraz podany wielkimi literami obok luki. Wymagana jest calkowita poprawnosc ortograficzna. W tym cwiczeniu wystarczy dodac koncowke - zaden wyraz nie potrzebuje przedrostka.

items.sentence: My grandmother is eighty but she is still very __________.

Plastic bags are extremely __________ to sea animals.
Big Ben is one of the most __________ buildings in the world.
They carried out a __________ study of the whole forest.
The engine is quiet, but the old one was very __________.
Most of the city's __________ areas were built in the 1960s.
The park looks wild, but almost nothing there is __________.
